name: hutch
description: Hutch build toolchain: Tailwind + daisyUI for app and marketing site

scripts.check:agent: uv run --frozen --no-sync python scripts/audit_context_hygiene.py && uv run --frozen --no-sync python scripts/audit_tool_contracts.py && uv run --frozen --no-sync python scripts/audit_constitution.py && uv run --frozen --no-sync python scripts/generate_agent_map.py --check
scripts.build:css: npm run build:css:site && npm run build:css:app
scripts.build:css:site: tailwindcss -i website/src/input.css -o website/app.css --minify && tailwindcss -i website/styles.css -o website/styles.min.css --minify && node scripts/stamp_site_assets.mjs
